title: Subpage toolbar
description: The sticky row with a page's filters on the left and search, refresh and the icon-only primary action on the right: under the page title, or with the title on the same row (title). RefreshButton spins while its promise runs.
when: A page whose filters and actions fit beside its title (one or two filters, a few actions): pass title and drop the PageTitle, so the content starts higher.

instead.need: Many filters, or filters that need the full width
instead.use: PageTitle above, SubpageToolbar on its own row (no title)

a11y: The primary action is icon-only, so primaryActionLabel is required (aria-label + title).
notes: Two layouts, both valid: PageTitle + SubpageToolbar (title on its own row), or SubpageToolbar with title (one row). Pick one per page, never both.
With title, a string becomes the page h1 in PageTitle type; a PageTabsTitle works too. Narrow screens wrap the filters and actions below the title.
Text buttons belong in right (secondary actions); the title itself stays text only and the primary action stays icon-only.
